surat pembaca.es: carta de lectores; carta al director
surat pembaca.en: Letter from readers; letter to the director

sependapat.es: estar de acuerdo; compartir una opinión

sejalan.en: to match; to be in tune

keberatan.en: objection; not to be in conformity

texto: **Sependapat** and **sejalan** express that you share an opinion. **Keberatan dengan** introduces an objection; it is appropriate to explain the reason without attacking anyone who thinks different.
Indonesian does not use a different verbal form for «I» and «her.»: the context identifies the person.

A review can be firm and at the same time **santun**. The **kesantunan** depends on the choice of words and how the request is presented. Avoid expressions that can **menyinggung** to the target person.
